primary_decision: maximum residue recall at empirical precision >=0.90 with >=50 TP and score ties intact
guardrail: no-linker-protein specificity loss <=0.02 absolute versus weighted-BCE

first_trial.mechanism: query/value LoRA adaptation of ESM-2 35M with residue CNN

second_trial.mechanism: Remove predicted intervals shorter than four residues after thresholding the unchanged weighted-BCE residue scores
second_trial.hypothesis: A minimum length supported by the training-fold annotations may eliminate short false-positive intervals while preserving enough true-positive residues to improve the frozen high-precision recall
second_trial.expected_failure: Thresholding can fragment genuine linkers into short intervals, so filtering may reduce recall more than false positives
second_trial.basis: All 1350 contiguous positive training spans are at least four residues; fold-4 error audit found 13 of 15 false-only predicted spans shorter than five residues. This is development-informed, not independent evidence.
second_trial.candidate_thresholds: all exact unique scores, ties intact; select maximum recall subject to frozen >=0.90 empirical precision and >=50 TP
second_trial.comparator: same checkpoint, validation fold, scores and operating-point selection, without the minimum-length decoder

third_trial.mechanism: Apply the unchanged four-residue minimum-span decoder to the already-trained asymmetric 35M checkpoint
third_trial.hypothesis: The fixed decoder may complement the asymmetric residue scorer and improve high-precision recall over that checkpoint without exceeding the no-linker specificity guardrail
third_trial.expected_failure: Asymmetric scores may fragment genuine linker spans, causing a smaller gain or a loss
third_trial.candidate_thresholds: all exact unique scores, ties intact; select maximum recall subject to frozen >=0.90 empirical precision and >=50 TP
third_trial.comparators: same asymmetric checkpoint without decoder and weighted-BCE checkpoint with and without decoder, on the same fold and metrics

on_completed_trial: record metrics and hashes, compare guardrail, then select the next independent mechanism or repeat a promising variant with another seed
on_failed_trial: record error, diagnose once, then move to safe data or evaluation work; never silently retry indefinitely
on_unverified_label_semantics: do not train a source-code head; continue an independently eligible trial or explicit data audit
